scores_meta.rules: Signal strength 0–100 = quality 30 (ROCE/ROE, debt, margin, earnings consistency, holdings) + trend 25 (averages, 52-week setup, RSI, 6-month return) + reason 20 (exchange filings since the last session, the 52-week setup, positional lists) + size 15 (Nifty 50 highest, then Nifty 100, 200 / Midcap 150, Nifty 500, F&O, market cap) + participation 10 (volume against its usual by now, trade sides, lists) − penalties for pump-and-dump traits (tiny market cap, penny price, NSE 5 % / 2 % price band, locked at the upper band, the exchange's volume / price queries, a negative filing, unexplained volume spike, parabolic run without earnings, losses, pledge, thin holdings, extreme volatility, chasing far above the 20-day average). Long only; ETFs are not scored. Weights set by hand, not back-tested.
scores_meta.plan_rules: Strong signals (score ≥ 70) only: Entry = the live price when the score first reached 70; Stop loss = Entry − 2 × ATR(14), judged on daily closes; Target 1 = Entry + 2 × risk; Target 2 = Entry + 4 × risk; trend exit = a daily close below the 20-day average (it rises as the trend runs). Positional, not intraday.
scores_meta.caveat: A rule-based score and rule-based levels (scan-plan-v3), frozen when the stock first reached 70. Not investment advice; no accuracy or hit rate is claimed. Fundamentals are the feature store's latest and can lag a filing made today.
